meta.review_notes: Complete re-analysis based on 34,196 character privacy policy. Key findings: extensive data collection for Captains including background location, government IDs, health data; data sharing with TPSPs and for market research; explicit statement of no targeted advertising; 180-day retention post-account closure.

app.name: Rapido: Bike-Taxi, Auto & Cabs
app.description: Bike-taxi, auto and cab ride-hailing service in India.

verdict.one_liner: Collects extensive location, identity, and device data, but explicitly avoids targeted advertising.
verdict.summary: Rapido gathers significant personal data including background location for Captains, government IDs, health declarations, and broad device information. On the positive side, it states it does not use data for targeted advertising and limits retention to 180 days after account closure.
verdict.recommendation_reason: If you are a Customer, location sharing is limited to active trips. If you are a Captain, be aware that extensive personal data including government IDs and background location are required.

red.title: Captains' location is collected when the app is closed
red.plain_english: Rapido collects location data in the background whenever Captains enable On-Duty, even when the app is not in use.

red.title: Government IDs and selfies may be required for Captains
red.plain_english: Rapido collects Aadhaar, PAN, driving license, and real-time selfies for identity verification.

red.title: May collect health information from Captains
red.plain_english: Rapido may collect body temperature, symptoms, and vaccination status from Captains.

red.title: Your data may be shared for market research and other purposes
red.plain_english: Rapido may share your information with third parties for market studies, data analysis, and to make other benefits or services available to you.

red.title: Calls with Rapido are recorded for Captains
red.plain_english: If you are a Captain or Vendor Partner, Rapido records your calls with them and stores related call details.

green.title: No targeted advertising
green.plain_english: Rapido explicitly states it does not use your information for targeted advertising.

green.title: Data deleted after 180 days
green.plain_english: After account termination, Rapido retains data for only 180 days before deletion or anonymization.

green.title: Complies with Indian IT Act
green.plain_english: Rapido states compliance with the Information Technology Act, 2000 and applicable laws.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Camera is used for Captains and Vendor Partners to upload profile pictures, vehicle documents, and real-time selfies for identity verification.
categories.detail: Camera access is required for identity verification and document uploads for Captains. Customers may not need it.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you are a Captain we may also require you to capture your real time self-clicked images (selfies) and upload such selfies on the Rapido Platform.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Rapido collects precise location during active trips and tracks Captains in the background when On-Duty is enabled.
categories.detail: Customers: location collected from request until trip finish when app is in foreground. Captains: background location collected when On-Duty icon is active.
categories.policy_excerpt: Rapido collects location data when the Rapido App is running in the foreground (app is open and on-screen) or background (app is not in use) in your mobile device.
concerns: Customer location linked to account even if customer does not enable location

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Rapido may collect emergency contact details and, if you refer a friend, their name and contact information.
categories.detail: Contact data is not broadly collected for all users, but referral features and emergency contacts involve collecting others' data.
categories.policy_excerpt: In case you refer a friend, we may also collect, store, and use the name and contact information of your friend to promote our Services.
concerns: Referral data collected without consent of the friend

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Rapido may access other apps on your device if you are a Captain or Vendor Partner to help prevent fraud.
categories.detail: The policy mentions accessing other applications on the Device for fraud prevention purposes for Captains/Vendor Partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: In case you sign up as a Captain or a Vendor Partner, enable features that require Rapido's access to other applications on your Device aiming to prevent and detect fraud towards the Customers.
concerns: Access to other apps on device for Captains

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Rapido shares data with service providers, co-branded partners, government agencies, and for market research purposes.
categories.detail: Data is shared with TPSPs, business partners, analytics providers, payment processors, government, and for corporate transfers.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may share the Information you provide with our TPSPs, business partners, and agents.
concerns: Broad sharing for market research and business purposes

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Rapido collects extensive identity data including government IDs, photos, KYC documents, and banking information.
categories.detail: Account information includes email, name, address, mobile, gender, DOB, photo, password, banking info, plus government IDs and vehicle documents for Captains.
categories.policy_excerpt: Account Information: Create or update your Rapido account which may include your email address, name, address, mobile number, gender, date of birth, photograph... banking or payment related information... copies of government issued identification documents such as Aadhaar, Permanent Account Number, etc.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Rapido tracks usage patterns and device behavior for fraud prevention and personalization, but says it does not use data for targeted ads.
categories.detail: Usage info, searches, touch gestures, scrolling, and other behavior are collected. The policy explicitly states no targeted advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Please note, we do not use the information collected from you for targeted advertising.
concerns: Extensive behavior tracking despite no targeted ads

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app is not for children under 18 and requires legally binding contract capacity.
categories.detail: Rapido explicitly states it does not knowingly collect information from children under 18 and requires users to be able to enter into legally binding contracts.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not knowingly solicit or collect Information from children under the age of 18 years. Use of the Rapido App is only available for persons who can enter into a legally binding contract under Applicable Laws.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Rapido logs your IP address, browser type, and usage patterns for security and fraud detection.
categories.detail: Usage Information includes browser, URL referrer, areas visited, time, searches, and behavior on the app.
categories.policy_excerpt: This Usage Information may include the browser that you are using, the URL that referred you to our Services, all of the areas within our Services that you visit, and the time of day, searches and search results, or usage behavior on the Rapido App.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Rapido collects detailed device and usage behavior information, including touch gestures and scrolling. It explicitly states this data is not used for targeted advertising.
categories.detail: Device information includes technical info, aggregated usage, device identifier, manufacturer, model, OS, geolocation, mobile network, screens visited, touch gestures, scrolling, and actions performed. The policy explicitly states: 'Please note, we do not use the information collected from you for targeted advertising.'
categories.policy_excerpt: Device Identifier of your Device, your preferred language and country site, manufacturer, software, and model of your Device, Device type, operating systems and versions, your geolocation, mobile network data, screens you have visited, your touch gestures performed in your Rapido App, your scrolling activity, and any other actions you have performed during your use of Rapido App.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Rapido may collect health-related information like body temperature, symptoms, and vaccination status from Captains.
categories.detail: Health data is collected from Captains including body temperature, symptoms, vaccination status, and other health conditions.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you are a Captain, we may collect certain health related Information and declarations such as body temperature, symptoms, vaccination status and other health conditions.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Rapido collects banking and payment-related information to process transactions.
categories.detail: Payment and banking information is collected as permitted by applicable laws.
categories.policy_excerpt: Account Information: Create or update your Rapido account which may include... banking or payment related information (as permitted by Applicable Laws).

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can cancel your account and request data deletion, but data is retained for 180 days after termination.
categories.detail: Users can delete their account and request changes, but Rapido retains data for 180 days post-termination before deletion or anonymization.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will retain your Information including Personal Information and Usage Information (including geo-location, trip history, and transaction history) for a period of 180 days, to resolve disputes... After completion of such period, your data may either be deleted from our database or be anonymized and aggregated.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Rapido may update its policy at any time, and continued use after changes means you accept them. Material changes may be notified by email or app notice.
categories.detail: Changes are effective immediately upon posting. Material changes get email or app notice, but continued use equals acceptance.
categories.policy_excerpt: Any changes will be effective immediately upon the posting of the revised Policy on the Rapido Platform. If we make any material changes, we will notify you by email (sent to the e-mail address specified in your account) or by means of a notice on the Rapido App prior to the change becoming effective.
